topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed array placement optimizes coverage by reducing spillover and taper loss, enhancing robustness against feed failures. This design choice mitigates gain loss, allowing continued network operation with reduced performance impact, and maintains link margin in challenging channel conditions.
reference_context: Defocused arrays reduce scan loss and spillover loss, with total loss of 8.46 dB at 2 dB, enhancing system reliability.
